I wrote the RPN calculator to `main.wj`. It handled all the cases I fed it through the interpreter. That run covered both of your examples, a blank line, `-7 2 /` (gave `-3`, truncating toward zero), and `3 -` (gave `error: underflow`).

I didn't run `wj build`, as instructed, so the compiled path is untested.
